title: HOMELESSNESS AND HEALTH and BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEES' REPORT relative to the Emergency Weather Response Report - Winter Shelter Program and Inclement…
text:
[Council File 26-0600-S118]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
HOMELESSNESS AND HEALTH and BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEES' REPORT relative to the Emergency Weather Response Report - Winter Shelter Program and Inclement Weather Program.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
A. Homelessness and Health Committee Report
1. TRANSFER up to $1,560,735 from the Unappropriated Balance (UB) Fund No. 100/58, Account No. 580454, Winter Shelter Program, to a new account within the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) Fund No. 10A/43, Account No. 43EA80, Winter Shelter Program to provide funding for motel vouchers to be used during activations through March 31, 2027.
2. INSTRUCT the General Manager, LAHD, or designee, to amend the FY 2026-27 General Fund agreement (C-205714) with the Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority (LAHSA) to add $1,560,735 for a new up to total contract amount of $57,227,323.85 with the following allocation:
Add up to $1,560,735 for Fiscal Year (FY) 2026-27 expenses for a new up to amount of $28,278,055.35 in Shelter and Housing Interventions.
3. REQUEST the LAHSA to report back on a strategy to ensure that the Winter Shelter program is meeting the needs in the district with the highest number from the most recent Point-in-Time Count.
4. INSTRUCT the City Administrative Office (CAO) with the Homelessness Oversight Bureau in the LAHD to report on future implementation of, if and when the LAHSA dissolution would have occurred, on how the function of these activations could be conducted by the LAHD instead of LAHSA.
5. DIRECT the CAO with the Homelessness Oversight Bureau and the Chief Legislative Analyst to report on the Winter Shelter motel activations occurring via Council Motion, if possible.
6. REQUEST the County’s Homeless Services and Housing Department to allocate a portion of its set aside of $4 million for El Nino related programming to the City’s Winter Shelter Program. B. Budget and Finance Committee Report
1. TRANSFER up to $1,560,735 from the Unappropriated Balance (UB) Fund No. 100/58, Account No. 580454, Winter Shelter Program, to a new account within the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) Fund No. 10A/43, Account No. 43EA80, Winter Shelter Program, to provide funding for motel vouchers to be used during activations through March 31, 2027.
2. INSTRUCT the General Manager, LAHD, or designee, to amend the Fiscal Year (FY) 2026-27 General Fund agreement (C-205714) with the Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority (LAHSA) to add $1,560,735 for a new up to total contract amount of $57,227,323.85 with the following allocation:
a. Add up to $1,560,735 for FY 2026-27 expenses for a new up to amount of $28,278,055.35 in Shelter and Housing Interventions.
3. INSTRUCT the City Administrative Officer (CAO) to review the following idle accounts for eligible money to support the Winter Shelter and Inclement Weather Programs:
a. Account No. 489 - Essential Public Utilities Assessment: $419,254
b. Account No. 813 - Bureau of Engineering / Assessment - Special Assessment Dep: $343,981
c. Account No. 62S - 2019-2022 United Way of Greater LA Housing Crisis Response Team Implementation Grant: $1,015,019
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The CAO reports that there is no General Fund impact as a result of the recommendations in this report. The recommendations in this report utilize funding from the proposed FY 2026-27 General Fund budget and Homeless Housing, Assistance and Prevention Program. Financial policies The CAO reports that the recommendations in its report comply with the City statement Financial Policies in that budgeted funds are being used to fund recommended actions.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(This matter is also referred to the Budget and Finance Committee)
summary: A City Administrative Officer report on the city's emergency weather response, covering the Winter Shelter Program and the Inclement Weather Program. The Homelessness and Health Committee approved it as amended.
